added: A program can now record four optional times under its event date: when the dance starts and ends, when the beginner lesson starts, and when you need to arrive at the hall. Set, change or clear each one in the editor with the time picker. They show in your language's 12- or 24-hour clock on one line on the program's summary, an end earlier than the start reads as the next day, and you can set them before you know the date.
When a program is linked to a saved venue with a usual time, the editor shows that time as a hint beside the time fields. It never fills them in or changes the venue.

The shared set list and the PDF show the start and end times beside the date and the lesson time below it. Arrive by stays off them, but a program file you share keeps it, so a guest caller knows when to arrive.

Duplicating a program keeps its times. They sync to your other devices and are kept in backups. An older version of the app won't replace your library with a backup that holds them, and warns when it imports one.
changed: Settings ▸ Program ▸ Sharing's "Include date and venue" switch is now "Include date, times and venue", and also covers the start, end and lesson times.
data_migrations: The database's move to schema v42 also adds a place for each program's start, end, lesson and arrival times. Every existing program starts with none.

added: Program.startMinute, endMinute, lessonMinute and arrivalMinute (schema v42 columns programs.start_minute, end_minute, lesson_minute, arrival_minute): optional minutes after midnight, validated 0-1439 in the constructor, with no time zone; Program.endsNextDay and Program.hasTimes. Duplicate keeps them; a Caller's Companion re-import keeps the prior times.

Carry the four times in the archive codec and the program sync wire mapping (written only when set), stamping archive envelope v8 (archiveSchemaVersionProgramTimes) when a program has one. Classify the columns in the privacy registry (arrival_minute with subject appUser) and list them in syncUserVisibleFields.

programToPlainText and programHeaderLines take formatTime and print the dance's start and end beside the date and the lesson on its own line, never the arrival time; programDanceTimes and isoTimeOfDay are exported. ProgramExportLabels gains lesson, timeRange, endsAt and nextDay.
